fields.finalNotes: All nine checks passed against the local API on the feature/menus-m1-spine branch, exercising one assigned screen. Three defects were found and fixed while preparing this demo: the migration could not drop AvailabilityResetUtc while an index depended on it; the menu read omitted the new settings columns so PublishedVersion always returned null; and the three new capability ids were seeded in the database but never registered in the canonical capability model, so history requests returned 500. Milestone 1 is accepted. It still requires an independent review before merge (never by its author, per issue #659).
